comment: Recall@5 / MRR / nDCG@5 floors for scripts/eval-check.js. Every production retrieval configuration MUST have a floor — the gate fails on a run with no committed baseline (v1.18.3). Both corpora measure 1.000 on every config as of 2026-11-03 (v1.20.1 compound-token fix: hyphenated/underscored topics now also index their parts, which recovered the two gold queries that previously returned nothing and the two that ranked the exact match second). Floors are set so one lost query out of 12 passes and two fail, on BOTH corpora — and so hybrid may never again silently rank below keyword, which the pre-fix gold floors tolerated. Update only after deliberate ranker improvements.
